chunks: From him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from al-Asamm, from Mis'mam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade the monkey from being bought or sold.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on buying and selling monkeys according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on earnings, this hadith establishes the prohibition of buying and selling monkeys, reflecting the broader juristic discourse on the commercialization of animals. The chain of transmission highlights the reliability of the Kufan school of hadith, while the ruling underscores the principle of removing unnecessary commercial activity from the marketplace to maintain economic purity.
